How Much Does It Cost To Replace A Pool Liner

 

Replacing a pool liner typically costs between $5000-$12,000 + HST with the average cost being between $5500 and $8000.

The most common factors that affect the price include.

 

  • Pool Size, Shape, & Depth
  • Refilling the pool water by tap or having water trucked in
  • Liner pattern selection
  • Built in vinyl over steel features such as steps & benches
  • Extra repairs to the pools bottom, walls, coping, or other pool repairs

 
How Long Does It Take To Replace A Pool Liner?

Most pool liners can be replaced in 1-day if the replacement water is trucked in.

If you wish to fill your pool with a garden hose it can take up between 2-5 days to refill your pool.

Depending on the condition of your pool we may need to drain your pool and cut out the existing liner to get the proper liner measurements.

Once the measurements have been taken it takes approximately 3 weeks to receive and install the liner.

If your pool is clean and still in good condition we can measure the pool with it full of water.

 
What Thickness Liner Does Hipel Pools Install?

Our inground pool liners typically range in thickness from 25 mil - 30 mil depending on the specific pattern. 

This is a standard thickness for inground pool liners.
Are There Extra Costs When Replacing A Pool Liner

You could face some additional hidden costs when replacing a pool liner.

These costs often can't be determined until the old liner is removed.

Examples of hidden costs include

  • Structural repairs to corroded or rusted wall panels
  • Repairs to damaged concrete/vermiculite on the pool floor
  • Making main drains VGB compliant or removing them altogether
  • Replacing corroded or damaged skimmers and returns 

 

 
How Often Do Vinyl Pool Liners Need To Be Replaced?

On average pool liners last between 8-12 years. However it is not uncommon for us to replace liners that are 15-20 years old.

How long a liner lasts is directly correlated to how well you look after your pool, particularly keeping your water chemistry in balance.
What Is The Best Time Of Year To Replace A Pool Liner?

Early spring & fall are the most popular times for replacing a pool liner. This way your swimming season isn't affected to dramatically by the liner replacement process.

We are able to install liners all summer long for people who have the need during the summer months.
